reasoning: This was a single-arm safety/tolerability study of tirbanibulin ointment 1% in actinic keratosis patients. Step 1 (TARGET ENGAGEMENT): No direct target engagement data provided, but topical application with observed local skin reactions suggests drug delivery and biological activity. Step 2 (PATHWAY MODULATION): Local skin reactions (erythema, flaking, crusting, swelling) are consistent with tubulin polymerization inhibition causing keratinocyte disruption and inflammatory response. Step 3 (CLINICAL TRANSLATION): Primary endpoint was tolerability, not efficacy. Peak composite tolerability score of 4.1 at Day 8 returning to baseline by Day 57 demonstrates acceptable tolerability profile. Step 4 (POPULATION EFFECTS): No subgroup analysis reported in this safety study. Step 5 (CONFOUNDERS): Single-arm design appropriate for safety assessment, adequate sample size (n=105), appropriate follow-up duration to assess tolerability recovery.
